title: MV Visustella Steamworks Mod not recognizing greenworks-win32 node

posts.author: Rocketlex
posts.body:
Hi All!
I've looked around, and I'm seeing a lot of people seem to be having issues with Greenworks right now, but the problem I'm having doesn't quite line up with the ones I'm seeing, so I thought I'd ask.  This is my first time using any kind of Steamworks integration, and while I feel like I followed all the instructions correctly, it's not working and I think I'm just not understanding how this works.
Currently, I'm just trying to use
Visustella's Steamworks
Plugin to unlock achievements in my game.  The achievements are all set up and ready to go, and the plugin calls have all been placed where they need to be.  However, the plugin seems to just not be working at all.  Pressing F8 while the editor-playtest version of my game is open reveals this.
It just...can't see the node, I guess.  But, it's there!  I put it in the libs folder just like the mod told me to.
It's there alongside all the other files the mod instructions said to include.  (I don't know why the error is saying \libs/lib.  I actually tried making a lib subfolder within libs and putting the node in there but that just made things worse AND made me feel like an idiot.)
I've tried swapping out node versions, since apparently there have been compatibility issues, but it always results in the same error so clearly there's something more fundamentally wrong with how I put this all together.  I'm getting the feeling either the
plugin instructions
are incomplete or I'm just completely misunderstanding how this is supposed to work.  Does anyone have any ideas?
Also here's my plugins order in case that reveals anything.  I moved the steamworks plugin way high up and it didn't help.)
